One paper was accepted for publication at the International Conference on Information Visualization Theory and Applications (SciTePress IVAPP 2021, part of VISIGRAPP 2021).

  • Daniel Atzberger, Tim Cech, Merlin de la Haye, Maximilian Söchting, Willy Scheibel, Daniel Limberger, and Jürgen Döllner: "Software Forest: A Visualization of Semantic Similarities in Source Code using a Tree Metaphor"

The conference is held as a virtual conference from February 8th until February 10th. More information at www.ivapp.visigrapp.org/.
